Join Our Team
Extraordinary people (like you), doing their greatest work to power extraordinary experiences. Are you ready to make your career Momentus?Our job openings
Recognitions
We’re lucky to be recognized with awards that emphasize our core values and being a great place to work.
Shaping The Future of Events Together
Momentus provides industry-leading venue and event management software to customers in over 60 countries around the world. Our clients include Super Bowl stadiums, Olympic arenas, famous museums and theaters, prestigious universities, Fortune 500 companies and the world’s largest convention centers.
Driven by Passion. Powered by Action.Our team is made up of passionate doers who thrive in a casual, energetic environment. If you’re someone who takes initiative and values a culture that blends hard work with fun, you’ll find your place here. Check out our open positions below!
Locations and Remote Work Opportunities
Embrace flexibility and seize opportunities from anywhere in the world with our expansive array of remote work options, designed to prioritize our employees' needs and aspirations. 
Discover boundless possibilities as you join our global team, where remote work isn't just a perk—it's a culture that fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, tailored to empower every member of our workforce.
Our Culture
At Momentus, you'll be surrounded by colleagues based all around the world in North America, Asia-Pacific, Europe and the Middle East.
Commitment
We work in a culture that values deep trust and high expectations.
Engagement
We are a community of motivated individuals who know how to have fun.
Connection
We nurture connections among our diverse team, fostering an inclusive environment.
Our Job Openings
What Employees Are Saying
Working at Momentus gives us the opportunity to empower our customers to create events where people can gather and form or strengthen real world bonds. In a world of digitization, these events are critical in helping maintain human connection.
“We are a truly remote first culture. This allows people to work in the way that works best for them. I can be more involved with my kids' lives without sacrificing my career. This also requires a level of trust in each other that I have not had in previous roles.”
John
Manager, Software Engineering, US
Momentus is an environment where everyone is ready and willing to help. The leadership always puts the customer first and helps you make deals happen. I have learned so much since joining this company and truly value the network I've made. To work here you must be fast and innovative. If you have both of those qualities you will be successful.
Mary Grace
Account Manager, US
Momentus is the perfect place for performance-driven professionals who value growth and flexibility. With remote work, adaptable hours, and a culture that fosters genuine connections, it’s easy to thrive and build lasting relationships. It’s also incredibly rewarding to deliver solutions that make a real difference for our customers.
Samy
Manager, Professional Services, France 
I love working at Momentus: the people, the passion, and the innovation make it a place where you can really thrive. In just four years, I’ve grown from Consultant to Team Lead thanks to the support and focus we put into developing each other.
Hayley
Team Lead, Professional Services, US
I’ve worked plenty of remote jobs, but none compare to Momentus. Even at a fully remote, large-scale international company, I feel seen, supported, and like I can make a real impact, all while staying more connected to my colleagues than I ever was in person. It’s been an amazing step for my career growth!
Megan
Sales Development Representative, US
Working at Momentus is an incredibly rewarding experience. A mutual feeling of trust and appreciation towards colleagues and managers creates an environment of trust where talent can thrive. Ever since I started working here, I no longer dread Monday mornings.
Fabian
Head of Data, Germany
I really enjoy working with robust and comprehensive solutions that have a meaningful impact for our clients. It’s rewarding to collaborate with our client, understand their needs, and show how we can help. I also feel fortunate to work alongside so many great colleagues across the company, including many I’ve shared the past 15 years with.
Rob
Sr. Solutions Engineer, US
“I’m surrounded by people who are all highly driven, and highly motivated, and they are all experts in different areas, whether that’s sales, marketing, service or engineering.”
Brian
Sr. Director, Product Management, US
“If you’re looking for a job in an international company, love taking on challenges, are ready to learn, and if you’re passionate about what you’re doing, Momentous could be just perfect for you. A great team of wonderful, talented people!”
Christiane
Accounting Administrator, Germany
“The aspect I love most about working at Momentus is the work environment and the culture it fosters. The commitment and dedication of every team member are palpable, and there is a strong sense of camaraderie.”
Dylan
Solutions Engineer, US
